outcome: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women in their third trimester requiring labour induction with misoprostol.
finding: Vaginal misoprostol demonstrated slightly better efficacy in cervical ripening, reduced caesarean section rates, and shorter induction-to-delivery intervals compared to oral misoprostol for labour induction.
mod_finding: Vaginal misoprostol reduced caesarean section rates compared to oral misoprostol, while spontaneous vaginal delivery rates were similar for both administration routes.
